messages:
emi: heads up — new Next.js agent starter wiring Redwood SDK + LangChain has an auth retry mismatch between node and edge bundles.
raghul: short summary?
emi: Node flow: token refresh -> retry with new Authorization header. Edge/browser: retry reuses original Request and the header gets dropped on redirect, so refresh never takes.
tess: any stack trace?
emi: pasted:
```
FetchError: 401 Unauthorized
  at fetchWrapper (packages/sdk/dist/edge.js:92:14)
```
nate: is this the official starter or community example?
emi: official starter in the repo. README currently recommends REDWOOD_API_KEY in .env.local but our eval guide uses ephemeral refresh tokens. Docs mismatch confuses folks.
raghul: can you repro reliably?
emi: yes — small repro script in the starter that forces token expiry after 5s. Start dev, open /agent, then trigger calls and rotate key.
devex-bot: CI: e2e job failed on PR #412  snapshot diff on /agent.
tess: probable fix: when retrying, build a fresh Request and attach the token from token store instead of cloning headers. Edge fetch implementations drop manual headers on some redirects.
emi: agree. i'll add a unit + e2e test that simulates expiry using msw and jest fake timers.
nate: also update README to explain "static key for local dev" vs "ephemeral refresh for eval/CI". helps new hires pick right path.
raghul: add a telemetry counter sdk.auth_retry to catch regressions in production.
tess: PR opened with retry fix, test, and README edit. CI flaky initially due to real timers. switched to fake timers and it's stable.
devex-bot: CI: PR #412 passed (build 7012). :white_check_mark:
emi: merging, will post a short note in #devex-docs with repro + test snippet so other samplekits can copy.
nate: great — can we backport to vite/react and edge-sample starters too?
emi: yep planning backports this week.
